title: Duplicate AEAT client in InteliFactu
blocker: Ventanilla Única now produces the voluntary deadline in each debt detail when the portal provides a single valid date. It can also read the advertised original SRAF resolution, whose synthetic handoff produced the expected InteliFactu payment match. The current InteliFactu file adapter still omits the deadline and does not consume the resolution. The integration decision, published delivery and live parity are pending.
unblock: Approve the distribution boundary. Before replacing the legacy path, verify that the chosen importer persists the optional voluntary deadline and retains unique versus unresolved payment links, using a released package or agreed file contract and an authorized resolution sample.
notes: Decide whether InteliFactu depends on `ventanilla-unica` or keeps its own,
and file the result in both backlogs.

Current source confirms duplicated AEAT session and payment parsing. InteliFactu also owns payment-to-instalment matching and downstream accounting. Its existing headless administration task already records the decision to keep portal clients in ventanilla-unica.

2026-11-27: Replayed one synthetic debt and two standard MisPagos rows through the built Ventanilla Única readers and actual InteliFactu mapping functions. Identity, balance, date, amount and classification agreed on the compared fields. The file adapter kept the receipt metadata, formatted the payment concept differently, and omitted the legacy voluntary deadline and unique receipt linkage. The paid instalment was zero in the current calendar and still carried the original charge in the resolution parser. The integrity-checked npm 0.3.0 bundle exports both readers but does not contain the typed current calendar or the signed-resolution read. The comparison used only stubbed portal responses and pure storage mappers.

2026-11-27: Added the holder-bound SRAF resolution reader and CLI download in Ventanilla Única. A synthetic response delivered the original PDF bytes to InteliFactu’s existing pdftotext and resolution parser. Two original instalments were recovered and the expected unique payment-to-debt match passed. The normal dependency and file importer were not changed.

2026-11-27: The built debt sweep now exposes detail.fechaLimiteVoluntaria from the official voluntary deadline label as an ISO date. A mocked replay reconstructed table cells from 23 archived details. It preserved the date in all 20 unambiguous details and omitted it in all three contradictory ones. The replay did not contact the portal or write fiscal data.
